name: Leaders Cosmetics Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Seoul, South Korea, Leaders Cosmetics Co., Ltd. is a company dedicated to the creation and distribution of a wide array of cosmetic products. Its comprehensive offerings encompass solutions for cleansing, skin care, facial masks and packs, sun protection, makeup, and curated product sets. The firm, which commenced operations in 2004, was formerly known as Sansung Life & Science Co., Ltd. before officially adopting the name Leaders Cosmetics Co., Ltd. in April 2016.
